subject: general
question: Six girls G1, G2, G3, G4, G5 and G6 are sitting in a row, facing towards the east (but not necessarily in the same order). Two girls are sitting between G6 and G4. G6 is sitting at one of the ends. G1 is second to the right of G6. G2 is third to the left of G3. How many girls are sitting between G3 and G2?
solution:
**Given : **

 
• Six girls → **G1, G2, G3, G4, G5 and G6** 
 
• All the girls are sitting in a row, facing towards the east. 

**​Explanation :**

1) G6 is sitting at one of the ends.

2) G1 is second to the right of G6.
